purpose: Complete registry inventory and proposed work queue; no new visual/runtime fidelity acceptance is claimed.

statusVocabulary.queued: Proposed; owner not assigned and checks not run for this task.
statusVocabulary.historical_review_open: Earlier reviews exist; material parity gaps or owner reports remain.
statusVocabulary.implemented_unreviewed_current_goal: Source implementation exists; complete current-goal review is unproven.
statusVocabulary.reserved_in_progress: Current first-wave owner; do not assign a duplicate worker.
statusVocabulary.ready_registry_only: Visible by READY gate; not a current fidelity acceptance result.

requirements: Exact base/final source SHA, immutable source snapshot and raw detector reports.
Source claims have OSM identities or independently cited measurements; record unknowns and source dates. OSM tags > aerial measurements > explicit defaults. Street View comparison only.
Inspect matched source/game images; label provider/date/pose/scope and exclusions. Reference imagery stays outside git and publication; never include secrets.
Zero browser errors and mandatory foot,a logic 0 high / 0 medium after integrated changes. No unresolved material fidelity/gameplay defects accepted.
High quality world + traffic + mirror <=1500000 triangles and <=400 draw calls, including evolving traffic/hotspots, drone, night and weather/season views. Software GL is not hardware FPS evidence.
Commit owned changes plus unique handoff only. Root applies global README/spec/STATUS requests and integrates.
Audit complete playable core + 600 m scenery ring; counts/identities/height/roof/courtyard/parking/tree coverage and exclusions, not only route samples.
Aerial whole-area top-down overview + sufficiently low square tiles for crowns/cars; street comparisons of every drivable street, both sides plus forward views, exact comparable poses.
Apply >=90% researched chapter-front buildings; account for all remaining gaps. Real businesses/facilities only; inspect all doors/starts/route/closures/navigation.
Inspect day, night, winter/snow and chosen wet-weather scenes plus nearby drone angles; test collision walks/drive, pedestrians and carried-item body clearance.
Baseline/final complete district visual survey with traffic/mirror, hotspot and 120 s evolving-traffic stress; retain raw reports and explain each residual.
Independent source ledger for footprint/parts, dimensions, roof/tier support, facade, sign wording/facing and real entrances; retain uncertain details.
Inspect all sides at street height, close drone obliques/top, night and seasonal weather. Check physical collision and entrances/passages, source geometry suppression and district/scenery behavior.
Test all district and tourist-scene consumers of every changed builder; backdrop=true has no colliders. Shared-function aliases are one task.
Run syntax/build viewer for affected models and affected district/scene visual+performance checks; model build success alone does not establish fidelity.
Review every member spawn, postcard and >=3 walk poses at day/night against sourced references; cover the complete scene, adjacent facades, water/shore and backdrop.
Test continuous controller paths, all plaques/photo challenges/real activities, tour/map, bike/boat/elevator as applicable, desktop+mobile focus and achievement persistence.
Run spotDev.audit(); retain all findings, resolve genuine z-fights/phantom walls/invalid geometry/pedestrian overlap or classify with concrete evidence.
Spec15: <=1000000 scene triangles, <3 s load on a named supported measurement setup; overall <=400 draw calls. Report load/hardware limits rather than claiming software-GL FPS.
READY flip is a root/shared-core integration request after evidence acceptance. Listing/loadability never substitutes for full fidelity completion.
Treat shared helpers, render/material/schema, registry/readiness/activity catalogues and generic builders as single-owner systems.
Re-run all consumers of shared changes, including 24 spots/19 scenes for spot-core changes; source/geometry invariants and meaningful collision/crowd regressions.
Root reviews/cherry-picks each task into staging, runs combined logic/visual/controller/performance QA on a frozen tree.
Fetch current master, integrate newest owner changes, rerun affected checks; normal fast-forward/push only after combined gates pass.
Verify remote integrated SHA before deleting only this effort’s branches/worktrees; preserve unrelated changes and branches. No native /goal API is available; this is tracked task state.

execution.isolation: Separate worktree/checkout AND branch per concurrently active task. Branch-only isolation in one directory is unsafe. All proposed branches unique and not created by this inventory.
execution.sharedOwnership: One owner per shared helper, schema, generic data builder, registry/material/render system per wave. Function-scoped landmark workers may coexist only on disjoint functions/A/P/P2/L rows and integrate sequentially; landmarks-file-review is advisory serialization at integration.

waves.rule: Current six reserved workers/root ownership stays intact; do not spawn duplicates.
Apply reviewed reserved fixes first; freeze shared helpers. These run sequentially where dependencies require it.
At most six workers + root, each owns separate data/research. Only start when dependencies satisfied.
Address remaining sourced parity work after reserved failures and evidence are integrated.
Batches <=6; obey completed district dependencies; one owner per source function, bMurrow covers two IDs. Shared helper changes serialize through C-SHARED.
Batches <=6 after C-SPOTS and model dependencies; shared scenes never split among workers.
